done_when: The sign-off completeness check always runs on Codex, and on Windows it runs with a design folder of 80 screen images
why: On Windows the client sign-off completeness check cannot run: it picks Claude whenever Claude is installed, although only Codex can review the screen images (issue 1159), and on Codex the Windows launcher is a cmd shim, so passing one image flag per screen goes past the 8191-character command line limit (issue 1160)
